ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions vs 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels forming the perimeter and localized mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the center of both lobes; a continuous thick black border follows the trailing and leading edges; distinct vertical dark striations are visible on the lower-left lobe; tan/yellowish hue clusters are proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximate internal pixel angle of 65 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated topography along the entire trailing edge; irregular peak-to-valley amplitude; serrations are most prominent and elongated on the distal outer edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow an upward-tapering convex curve; trailing edges follow a complex concave trajectory from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected in the lower-left quadrant of the white field; white punctate spots visible against the dark pigmentation of the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal dark linear marks (rakes) breaking the white pigmentation field on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe shows an irregular blunted geometry compared to the sharper right tip, indicating potential tissue loss or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized diffuse yellowish-tan pigmentation patches situated in the interior white fields adjacent to the median notch.
